Get 30% Off Yarns & Kits, No Code Necessary – Offer Ends 108:45:29*some exclusions apply, click for details Please consider visiting our separate Canadian website for cheaper products and shipping. st(s) = stitch(es) The abbreviation stands for 'stitch'. There are many different types of stitches in knitting, but the most common are the knit stitch and the purl stitch.
